title: Step 1 - How to Prepare Data for Machine Learning: Training vs Test Sets

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome to this tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這堂課。

cues.en: Okay, so we are almost done with part one, data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 第一部分資料前處理快完成了。

cues.en: I can't wait to start making the machine learning models.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待想開始建立機器學習模型。

cues.en: We just need three more tutorials to make our dataset perfectly prepared before starting the models, and then we'll be good to go.
cues.zh: 再三堂課，就能把資料準備好，正式開始模型實作。

cues.en: Okay, so today, we're going to talk about the fact that we need to split the dataset into a training set, and a test set.
cues.zh: 今天要談的是，必須將資料集切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And I'll explain why we need to do that, right now.
cues.zh: 現在說明原因。

cues.en: So, let's go to Google Sheets.
cues.zh: 先到 Google Sheets。

cues.en: Well, I'm on Google Sheets, but you can be on Excel, you can be on whatever tool you want.
cues.zh: 我使用 Google Sheets，你也可以用 Excel，或其他喜歡的工具。

cues.en: But here is the dataset open with Google Sheets.
cues.zh: 這裡是用 Google Sheets 打開的資料集。

cues.en: So, we have our 10 observations, and this is the dataset.
cues.zh: 共有十筆觀測值。

cues.en: This is the whole dataset.
cues.zh: 這就是完整資料集。

cues.en: And what we should do in any machine learning models, is that we're gonna split this dataset into two separate sets, which are gonna be the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 建立任何機器學習模型時，都應把資料拆成兩個獨立部分，也就是訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Now, why do we need to do this?
cues.zh: 為什麼呢？

cues.en: Well, when you take a step back, and focus on the name, machine learning itself, you'll understand that this is about a machine, that is going to learn something.
cues.zh: 退一步想想「機器學習」這個名稱，就知道這是一台要學會某些事情的機器。

cues.en: Well, here, it's your algorithm, it's your model, that is going to learn from your data to make predictions, or other machine learning goals.
cues.zh: 在這裡，就是演算法或模型從資料學習，來做預測，或達成其他機器學習目標。

cues.en: And so, your machine learning model is going to learn to do something on your dataset by understanding some correlations that there is in your data set.
cues.zh: 模型會理解資料集中的某些關係，學會完成某項任務。

cues.en: And imagine your machine learning model is learning too much on the dataset, like it's learning too much the correlations, then I'm not sure it's performance would be great,
cues.zh: 但想像模型把資料集學得太熟，把其中的關係記得過度精確，那我不確定它在

cues.en: on a new set with slightly different correlations.
cues.zh: 關係稍有不同的新資料上，還能有好表現。

cues.en: You know, it's like a student who is learning by heart his lesson, and then when he takes the exam, he might be in trouble because he learned too much his lesson by heart, and he does not manage to make the connection
cues.zh: 就像學生把課文背得滾瓜爛熟，但到了考試卻遇到困難，因為只是死背，無法把

cues.en: between what he learned and the exam.
cues.zh: 學到的內容與考題連結起來。

cues.en: And it's the same for machine learning.
cues.zh: 機器學習也是一樣。

cues.en: We are going to build our machine learning models on a dataset, but then we have to test it on a new set which is gonna be slightly different from the dataset on which we build the machine learning model.
cues.zh: 我們在一份資料集上建立模型，再用和訓練資料略有不同的新資料測試。

cues.en: So, we have to make two different sets, a training set on which we build the machine learning model, and a test set on which we test the performance
cues.zh: 所以要分成兩份：用訓練集建立模型，再用測試集評估

cues.en: of this machine learning model.
cues.zh: 模型的效能。

cues.en: And the performance on the test set shouldn't be that different from the performance on the training set, because this would mean that the machine learning models understood well,
cues.zh: 測試集與訓練集上的表現不應差太多，因為這代表模型真正理解了

cues.en: the correlations and didn't learn them by heart, so that he can adapt to new sets and new situations.
cues.zh: 資料的關係，而不是死記，才能適應新資料與新情境。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the idea about splitting the data set into a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 這就是切分訓練集與測試集的概念。

cues.en: And now, let's do it on R.
cues.zh: 現在在 R 裡操作。

cues.en: So here, we are on R.
cues.zh: 回到 R。

cues.en: The section is ready, splitting the dataset into the training set and test set.
cues.zh: 這一節已準備好，標題是切分訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And let's start coding the thing.
cues.zh: 開始寫程式。

cues.en: Now, that you understand well, the difference between a training set and a test set, we're gonna do it a little faster.
cues.zh: 既然已理解兩者的差別，這裡就加快一點。

cues.en: So, new thing here, we have to import a library.
cues.zh: 這次有新東西，需要匯入函式庫。

cues.en: We're going to import the library, that is going to make a good split of the dataset into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 這個函式庫會幫我們適當切分訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And this library is called caTools.
cues.zh: 它叫 caTools。

cues.en: So, let's import it.
cues.zh: 現在匯入。

cues.en: Here, I'm going to the packages tab to see the list of the libraries.
cues.zh: 到 Packages 分頁，查看函式庫清單。

cues.en: Here, you can see that the caTools library is here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到 caTools。

cues.en: I have it installed on the packages, because I installed it before, but it's probably not the case for you, if you're starting R for the first time.
cues.zh: 因為我之前安裝過，所以它已經存在；如果你第一次用 R，通常還沒有。

cues.en: So, we're gonna install it.
cues.zh: 所以先來安裝。

cues.en: To install a library in R, it's very simple.
cues.zh: 在 R 裡安裝函式庫很簡單。

cues.en: You have to type install dot packages, and then in parenthesis, quotes, and then the name of the library in quotes.
cues.zh: 輸入 install.packages，再用括號與引號，填入函式庫名稱。

cues.en: So here, we type caTools, and we're ready to go.
cues.zh: 這裡填 caTools，就準備好了。

cues.en: So, then you have to select this line, and press the Command+Control+Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取這行，再按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And right now, it's installing the package caTools.
cues.zh: 現在正在安裝 caTools 套件。

cues.en: Okay, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So, then you have to put it as a comment, because you won't need to install it again.
cues.zh: 接著把這行註解掉，因為之後不需要再次安裝。

cues.en: But then as you can see, we just installed the caTools library, but it's not activated yet.
cues.zh: 可以看到，caTools 雖然已安裝，卻還沒有載入。

cues.en: You know, it's not selected, and we have to select it.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有勾選，我們必須啟用它。

cues.en: So, to select a library, you have two choice.
cues.zh: 載入函式庫有兩種方式。

cues.en: Either you click on the box here, as you can see this, generate the script here.
cues.zh: 一種是直接勾選這個方框，就會自動產生這行指令。

cues.en: Or, you know, if you have some scripts that you wanna automate, and execute once in a time.
cues.zh: 另一種，如果想讓程式自動化，一次執行全部步驟，

cues.en: Well, you can specify in your script that you want to include the library.
cues.zh: 就可以直接在程式中指定載入函式庫。

cues.en: And to do this, you just need to type library, parenthesis, and caTools, the name of your library, not in quotes actually, this time,
cues.zh: 做法是寫 library，括號裡填 caTools，這次不需要引號。

cues.en: library, caTools.
cues.zh: 也就是 library(caTools)。

cues.en: Okay, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now, you're ready to go.
cues.zh: 現在準備好了。

cues.en: We can check caTools is not selected right now.
cues.zh: 目前 caTools 還沒有勾選。

cues.en: And if I select this, and press Command and Control to execute, now it is, now it's selected.
cues.zh: 選取這行並執行後，它就載入了，也已經勾選。
